newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech April real industr. sales up 10.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech April real industr. sales up 10.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech real industrial sales rose 10.1 percent year-on-year in April versus a fall of 0.8 percent in March, preliminary figures from the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) showed on Thursday.
The CSU said industrial sales were up 1.4 percent year-on-year in the first four months of the year.
NOTE: The CSU said that the main impetus behind April's growth in industrial sales was the transport sector. It added that there was one extra working day in April 1997 compared with April last year.
Final figures will be released on June 9.
